image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution underwater photograph of a Rock Beauty (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a coral reef. The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. The background consists of textured corals and rocks in muted purples, browns, and whites.
